why: A small bike workshop doing 39 services a month on half a mechanic's time and 183 a month with 2.5 mechanics works out to about 2 hours of labour per service, which is believable.
Gym quintiles averaging 11 to 80 sessions per member over six months (roughly 0.5 to 3 visits a week) are believable for a gym chain facing new competitors.
The workshop and repair costs ($46,600 and $3,700 for sofas) sit inside the $57,400 total, 31 repairs at about $119 each is around 4 hours at $29 per hour, and the $17 upholsterer wage is plausible.

A bindery making 55 wedding albums a month on half a binder's time and 262 in peak June with 2.5 binders is believable; about 1.5 hours per album is quick for hand binding but within a factor of a few.
Every office's sector split adds to 100%, and offices billing 19,000 to 88,000 hours a year at 63% to 84% utilisation fit a regional engineering consultancy.
All four grade distributions add to 100%, and 1,350 respondents making up 9% of a territory's customers (about 15,000 households) is believable for a grocery delivery firm.
A growing online tutoring firm with revenue rising from $24m to $131m and margins improving from -144% to -23% (costs of about $59m to $161m) is a believable investor-funded loss-maker.
A jewellery workshop resizing 26 rings a month on half a jeweller's time and 128 in December with 2.5 jewellers is believable; nearly 3 hours per resize is slow but within a factor of a few.
Direct and indirect contributions add to each industry's total (for example 0.8 + 0.4 = 1.2), and 3.9 percentage points of GDP growth over ten years across several countries is believable.
A fertilizer producer selling about 380,000 tonnes of nitrogen into a 2.2 to 3.2 million tonne market (a 12% to 17% share) and 480,000 tonnes of phosphate into a 2 million tonne market is believable.
A planetarium with 175,000 visits from 130,000 people, 70% of whom came once, implies repeat visitors averaging about 2.2 visits, which is believable.
A meat-substitute maker growing revenue from 19m to 124m euros while margins improve from -161% to -26% (costs of about 50m to 156m euros) is a believable investor-funded loss-maker.
